robot-viewer demo

Wren and SO-ARM100

Each robot below is one compressed GLB file and one web component, served from this folder with no other site involved. The page runs under default-src 'self'; base-uri 'none'; object-src 'none'; form-action 'none'.

01

Wren

Moving joints
6
Links
9
Triangles
6,860
Model file
119 KB

Pick a pose, or set each joint with its slider. Drag a part of the robot to move it. Drag the background to turn the view.

Embed this robot 
<!-- Wren: load the component once per page -->
<script type="module" src="robot-viewer.js"></script>
<robot-viewer src="wren.glb" poster="wren.poster.webp" alt="Wren, a small made-up desk arm with a two-finger gripper" pose="home" ik></robot-viewer>

Pick a pose, or set each joint with its slider. Drag a part of the robot to move it. Drag the background to turn the view.

Embed this robot 
<!-- SO-ARM100: load the component once per page -->
<script type="module" src="robot-viewer.js"></script>
<robot-viewer src="so100.glb" poster="so100.poster.webp" alt="SO-ARM100, an open-source 3D-printed robot arm designed by The Robot Studio" pose="ready" orbit="-60 18" ik></robot-viewer>

Joint limits come from each robot's URDF. Motion is illustrative: no collisions, torque or speed are checked.
